from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fit(f,p0):
    best=None
    for s in range(5):
        p=np.array(p0)*(1+0.3*np.random.randn(len(p0)))
        r=least_squares(lambda q: f(q)-dP_dt, p)
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    return np.round(best.x,4), 1-np.mean((f(best.x)-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
